pending.IEEE_INT-representable-round-nearest: For each ROUND value, probe IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(A) and IEEE_SUPPORT_ROUNDING(ROUND,A) for every A in the concrete row set before invoking IEEE_INT. Ties row A=[2.5,-2.5,3.5,-3.5]: IEEE_NEAREST -> [2,-2,4,-4] by ties-to-even; IEEE_AWAY -> [3,-3,4,-4] by nearest with ties away from zero; IEEE_UP -> [3,-2,4,-3]; IEEE_DOWN -> [2,-3,3,-4]; IEEE_TO_ZERO -> [2,-2,3,-3]. Non-ties row A=[2.3,-2.3,2.7,-2.7]: IEEE_NEAREST -> [2,-2,3,-3]; IEEE_AWAY -> [2,-2,3,-3] because non-ties still round to nearest; IEEE_UP -> [3,-2,3,-2]; IEEE_DOWN -> [2,-3,2,-3]; IEEE_TO_ZERO -> [2,-2,2,-2]. Hand-checked pair discriminators: NEAREST/AWAY by 2.5, NEAREST/UP by 2.5, NEAREST/DOWN by 3.5, NEAREST/TO_ZERO by 3.5, AWAY/UP by -3.5, AWAY/DOWN by 2.5, AWAY/TO_ZERO by 2.5, UP/DOWN by 2.3, UP/TO_ZERO by 2.3, and DOWN/TO_ZERO by -2.3.
